comparison_ledger.incumbent_local_function: Navigate to and inspect receptacles to locate the target object.
comparison_ledger.scope: ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks where the target object is a food item (e.g., egg) and the room contains both high-probability semantic containers (fridge) and low-probability open surfaces, testing if semantic prioritization outperforms spatial listing order.

comparison_ledger.incumbent_local_function: Select next receptacle to inspect based on search policy.
comparison_ledger.scope: ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks where the target object is hidden and multiple receptacle types are visible at entry, specifically testing semantic priors for food items.

comparison_ledger.incumbent_local_function: Navigate to and inspect a subset of candidate receptacles until the target object is found and taken.
comparison_ledger.scope: ALFWorld bathroom tasks where the target object is a toiletry (e.g., soap, toothpaste) and multiple closed storage receptacles are visible.

established_memories.guidance: When searching for an object, prioritize receptacle types that are semantically likely to contain the object (e.g., pans on stoves, food in fridges) rather than a fixed arbitrary priority (drawers > cabinets). If no semantic prior exists, use the spatial order from the initial observation as a baseline, as it may be more efficient than exhaustive type-grouping in rooms with mixed layouts.
established_memories.scope: ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks where the target object's location is unknown and multiple receptacle types are visible.

established_memories.guidance: After acquiring the target object, locate a sinkbasin, navigate to it, and clean the carried object using an available sinkbasin. Then carry the clean object to the requested destination and place it.
established_memories.scope: ALFWorld tasks requiring cleaning an object before final placement.

established_memories.guidance: After acquiring the target object, navigate to a microwave, open it if closed, put the object inside, close it, and execute heating. Then retrieve the heated object and place it on the final receptacle.
established_memories.scope: ALFWorld tasks requiring heating an object before final placement.

established_memories.guidance: After acquiring the target object, navigate to a fridge, open it if closed, place the object inside to cool it, then retrieve it and transport it to the destination.
established_memories.scope: ALFWorld tasks requiring cooling an object before final placement.
